name: learnace
description: Exam preparation platform: React + Express + Neon Postgres

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server install --omit=dev
